name: finance-approval-bridge
objective: The governed counterpart of the finance-approval-handoff MAF team: the same wire-transfer business action the team plans (intake -> wire, approval-gated MCP) is submitted through the real gateway, where it escalates for human approval (I6) instead of executing optimistically.
teaching: An orchestration team can DECLARE an approval gate on its tool, but the binding enforcement is the Control Plane: routed through the gateway, reading an invoice is allow-path and launching a wire transfer escalates to pending -- the team's plan and the governed verdict agree on where the human gate sits.

agents.system_prompt: You handle finance intake: read invoice status, request wire transfers (which require approval).

actions.rationale: Reading invoice status is a low-risk read by the finance admin -- allow-path.
A wire transfer is critical -- the gateway escalates it to a human approver (pending), matching the MCP approval=always gate the MAF team declares on its wire tool (I6).
